title: Hardware heat vs Longhorn (pinode-01 test)
description: Week-long passive test started 2026-10-10: is pinode-01 overheating (no fan) and is that what breaks its Longhorn volumes? Verdict due 2026-10-17. Lower rows (added 2026-10-10): NFS client statistics and QNAP reachability, to find out what a k8smaster NFS wedge looks like while it is happening.

panels.title: Temperature: CPU and NVMe drive, both nodes
panels.description: Pi 5 starts slowing the CPU around 80C and harder at 85C. pinode-01 has no fan. k8smaster is the control.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "temp" and r._field == "temp" and (r.sensor == "cpu_thermal" or r.sensor == "nvme_composite"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: r.host + " " + r.sensor}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: CPU clock (MHz, lowest in each window)
panels.description: Maximum is 2400. Low while the node is busy and hot = throttling. Low while idle is normal.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpufreq" and r._field == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: min, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value) / 1000.0, _field: r.host}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: Processes blocked on disk (stall detector)
panels.description: Was 200+ on pinode-01 when the Longhorn replicas failed on 2026-10-10. Normal is a handful.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "processes" and r._field == "blocked")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: r.host}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: Load average (1 min)
panels.description: Four cores: anything much above 4 means a queue.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r._field == "load1")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: r.host}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: Under-voltage alarm (1 = seen)
panels.description: A weak power supply causes the same symptoms as heat. Should stay at 0.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "rpi_undervoltage")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: r.host}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: Longhorn: volumes unhealthy, replicas failed
panels.description: Anything above 0 is a Longhorn fault. Compare the timing with the temperature panel.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "longhorn_health" and (r._field == "volumes_unhealthy" or r._field == "replicas_flagged_failed" or r._field == "replicas_not_running"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: Nodes Ready (1 = Ready)
panels.description: A dip is the node dropping out of the cluster.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "longhorn_health" and (r._field == "ready_pinode_01" or r._field == "ready_k8smaster"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: min, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: Event log: replica failures, node flaps, restarts
panels.description: One row per change, newest first. Recording started when this test began (2026-10-10).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "longhorn_event" and r._field == "text")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 200)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "kind", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "what happened"})

panels.title: NFS to the QNAP: retransmits and timeouts per minute
panels.description: Client-side counters from the node. Rising while tasks are stuck = network or QNAP not answering. Flat while tasks are stuck = the client itself.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nfs_mountstats" and (r._field == "retrans" or r._field == "timeouts"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1m, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: r.host + " " + r._field}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: NFS to the QNAP: TCP reconnects per minute
panels.description: The client re-making its connection to the QNAP. Frequent reconnects = the session keeps dropping.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nfs_mountstats" and (r._field == "connects"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1m, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: r.host + " " + r._field}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: NFS request time (ms per request, wire + queued)
panels.description: Time per NFS request, including time waiting in the client. Jumps before a wedge.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nfs_mountstats" and (r._field == "ops" or r._field == "rtt_ms" or r._field == "queue_ms"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1m, nonNegative: true)
  |> group(columns: ["host"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.ops > 0.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.rtt_ms / r.ops + r.queue_ms / r.ops, _field: r.host + " wire+queued"}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: QNAP port 2049 (NFS): TCP connect time from each node
panels.description: If this is fast while processes are stuck, the QNAP is reachable and the problem is not the network path. A gap = unreachable.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "net_response" and r.server == "192.168.20.30" and r._field == "response_time")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 1000.0, _field: r.host + " connect ms"}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: NFS requests waiting to send (client backlog)
panels.description: Requests queued in the client. Climbing while the QNAP answers fast = a client-side stall.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nfs_mountstats" and r._field == "backlog")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: r.host + " backlog"}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
